Copier Rental Pasig Service Checklist

A Pasig copier rental support article

Use this checklist alongside Copier Rental Pasig when your Ortigas, Kapitolyo, Bridgetowne, or Arcovia team needs a clearer way to compare service scope, hidden fees, and quote details.

Clarify service and support scope

  • Ask if installation, user orientation, and network setup are included.
  • Confirm how scan-to-email, shared folders, and user access will be configured.
  • Ask how response timing is handled when downtime affects a shared department.
  • Check whether replacement equipment is available if the unit becomes undersized.

Clarify pricing and consumables

  • Ask whether toner and routine service are included in the monthly fee.
  • Check if volume overages, relocation, pickup, or contract changes are billed separately.
  • State the district, number of users, expected monthly volume, and target deployment date.
  • Ask how the quote changes if the office needs color, duplex, or heavier scan workflows.
